boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Chapman University
boards.description: Discover the essential late-night food spots near Chapman University, from on-campus dining halls to the historic eateries of Old Towne Orange.

cards.title: Midnight Snacks at The Caf
cards.subtitle: On-campus dining hall
cards.notes: Visit the main dining hall for late-night food service until 1:00 AM daily, providing a safe on-campus option for students with meal plans.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus dining hall offering late-night service until 1:00 AM for Chapman students.
cards.evidence_claim: Randall Dining Commons serves until 1 a.m. every day for Chapman students.
cards.source_title: Dining | Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM daily for students; meal plans or payment required.

cards.title: Late Slices in the Circle
cards.subtitle: Old Towne Orange pizzeria
cards.notes: Walk two blocks to the Orange Circle for New York-style slices available until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: A local favorite in Old Towne Orange serving New York-style pizza with late-night weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Zito's Pizza in Old Town Orange is open Friday and Saturday from 11am to 1am.
cards.source_title: Locations - Zito's Pizza
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.

cards.title: The Tustin Avenue Run
cards.subtitle: Classic California burger joint
cards.notes: Drive to Tustin Street for a late-night Double-Double; the drive-thru stays open until 1:00 AM or later every night of the week.
cards.short_summary: A quintessential Southern California late-night destination located a short drive from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The In-N-Out at 2585 N. Tustin St. is open until 1:00 AM Sunday-Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Orange, CA, 2585 N. Tustin St. - In-N-Out Burger
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM (Sun-Thu) or 1:30 AM (Fri-Sat).

cards.title: 24-Hour Cravings
cards.subtitle: Fast food on Tustin Street
cards.notes: Head to the 24-hour Taco Bell on North Tustin Street for a reliable late-night meal at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast food option located near campus for students needing a meal after midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 490 N Tustin St in Orange is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Orange, CA - 490 N Tustin St
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Custom Pies in the Plaza
cards.subtitle: Build-your-own pizza
cards.notes: Create your own pizza at this newspaper-themed spot in Old Towne Orange, open until 11:00 PM or midnight for late study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A build-your-own pizza restaurant in the historic district with late evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pizza Press Orange is open until 11:00 PM Sunday-Thursday and 12:00 AM Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Orange, CA - The Pizza Press
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM (Sun-Thu) or 12:00 AM (Fri-Sat).

cards.title: Milky Bun Dessert Run
cards.subtitle: Hand-scooped ice cream
cards.notes: Grab a signature Milky Bun or a scoop of Cookie Monster ice cream at this Glassell Street shop, open until 10:00 PM or later.
cards.short_summary: A trendy ice cream shop in Old Towne Orange known for unique flavors and late-night dessert options.
cards.evidence_claim: Afters Ice Cream at 117 N Glassell St has online ordering hours until 10:10 PM.
cards.source_title: LOCATIONS - Afters Ice Cream
cards.access_notes: Open daily until at least 10:00 PM.

cards.title: The 24/7 Convenience Stop
cards.subtitle: Glassell Street convenience store
cards.notes: Stop by the 7-Eleven on Glassell Street for 24/7 access to snacks, drinks, and quick meals just north of the main campus area.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store providing essential snacks and supplies for late-night study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 1679 N. Glassell St is open 24/7.
cards.source_title: 1679 N. Glassell St Orange CA 92867-3615 - 7-Eleven
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Early Morning Coffee Run
cards.subtitle: Coffee and donuts
cards.notes: Fuel up for early morning classes or late-night cramming at the Dunkin' on Glassell Street, opening as early as 5:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A reliable spot for coffee and donuts with very early morning hours for Chapman students.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin' locations in the area typically open at 5:00 AM for early morning service.
cards.source_title: Find Your Nearest Dunkin' Location
cards.access_notes: Open early morning from 5:00 AM.

cards.title: On-Campus Caffeine
cards.subtitle: Campus coffee shop
cards.notes: Located in Beckman Hall, this on-campus Starbucks provides a convenient spot for coffee and snacks during evening study hours.
cards.short_summary: The central on-campus Starbucks location for students to gather and study with caffeine.
cards.evidence_claim: Starbucks is located in Beckman Hall on the Chapman campus.
cards.source_title: Dining | Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; typically open until 9:00 PM or 10:00 PM on weekdays.

cards.title: Argyros Forum Bagel Break
cards.subtitle: On-campus bagel shop
cards.notes: Grab a bagel or sandwich at Argyros Forum; this spot is a staple for students looking for a quick meal between evening activities.
cards.short_summary: A popular on-campus eatery in Argyros Forum offering bagels and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: Einstein Bros Bagels is located in Argyros Forum on the Chapman campus.
cards.source_title: Dining | Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Regular hours are Monday-Thursday until 5:00 PM, with some late-night availability during special events.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional study nooks, quiet reading rooms, and collaborative lounges that Chapman students use to escape the main campus crowds.

cards.title: Fashionables Terrace
cards.subtitle: Leatherby Libraries 4th Floor
cards.notes: Head to the 4th floor and turn left from the elevators to find this outdoor patio. It offers round tables with umbrellas and views of Wilson Field and the mountains.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor 4th-floor library terrace with tables and umbrellas for studying with a view.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fashionables Terrace is located on the 4th floor of the Leatherby Libraries and features outdoor tables and comfortable seating for study.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 8 AM to 5 PM, weather permitting.

cards.title: Argyros Forum Roof Patio
cards.subtitle: Argyros Forum Top Floor
cards.notes: Take the stairs to the top floor of Argyros Forum to access this quiet outdoor area. It features benches and tables away from the main student union noise.
cards.short_summary: A quiet rooftop patio on the top floor of the student union building.
cards.evidence_claim: The roof patio of Argyros Forum is a quiet and private study spot with plenty of tables and benches.
cards.source_title: Hidden Places to Study on Campus - The Voice of Wilkinson
cards.access_notes: Accessible during standard building hours.

cards.title: Keck Center Hallways
cards.subtitle: Keck Center for Science and Engineering
cards.notes: Use the erasable walls in the hallways to map out complex problems. These open collaborative spaces are designed for spontaneous group work between classes.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative hallway spaces featuring floor-to-ceiling erasable whiteboard walls.
cards.evidence_claim: The hallways in the Keck Center for Science and Engineering are designed with walls you can write on to foster collaboration.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for student use.

cards.title: Mezzanine Quiet Room
cards.subtitle: Sandi Simon Center for Dance
cards.notes: Located on the third-level mezzanine of the repurposed packing house, this intimate room is ideal for solo studying or small group collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study room located on the third-level mezzanine of the Dance Center.
cards.evidence_claim: A quiet room at the third-level mezzanine of the Sandi Simon Center for Dance offers an intimate space for studying alone or collaborating.
cards.source_title: Chapman University - Sandi Simon Center for Dance - SCUP
cards.access_notes: Located within the Sandi Simon Center for Dance.

cards.title: Huell Howser Archive Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Leatherby Libraries Lower Level
cards.notes: Find this quiet room on the lower level near the California's Gold exhibit. It offers a silent environment for focused reading and textbook work.
cards.short_summary: A silent reading room located within the Huell Howser Archives on the library's lower level.
cards.evidence_claim: The Huell Howser Archive reading room on the lower level of Leatherby Libraries is a quiet place for students to study.
cards.source_title: Did You Know You Could Study Here? - Leatherby Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM.

cards.title: Beckman Hall 4th Floor
cards.subtitle: Beckman Hall
cards.notes: Sit by the large windows on either side of the fourth floor for natural light. This floor is mostly offices, making it significantly quieter than the lower levels.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, sun-drenched hallway study area on the top floor of Beckman Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The fourth floor of Beckman Hall is quiet with large windows and a patio, making it a preferred study spot.
cards.source_title: The Best Study Spots at Chapman
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; typically quietest during office hours.

cards.title: Doti Hall Patio
cards.subtitle: Doti Hall East Side
cards.notes: Located on the east side of Doti Hall, this outdoor area has tables with umbrellas. It is a low-traffic alternative to the library's main outdoor seating.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor patio with umbrellas and benches on the east side of Doti Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Doti Hall patio on the east side of the building is a quiet location with plenty of tables and benches.
cards.source_title: Hidden Places to Study on Campus - The Voice of Wilkinson
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Prayer and Meditation Room
cards.subtitle: Fish Interfaith Center
cards.notes: Visit this room for a moment of silence or reflection. It is equipped with meditation cushions and prayer rugs and is open to all students regardless of belief.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet space for prayer, meditation, or silent reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fish Interfaith Center includes a prayer and meditation room with cushions and rugs, open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 9 PM.
cards.source_title: About Fish Interfaith Center - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 8 AM - 9 PM.

cards.title: DMAC Laptop Bars
cards.subtitle: Digital Media Arts Center
cards.notes: The DMAC features multiple laptop bars and a student lounge area with recliners. It's a high-tech environment inspired by industry studios like Pixar.
cards.short_summary: Modern laptop bars and lounge areas within the Digital Media Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Digital Media Arts Center includes multiple laptop bars and a student lounge area with couches and recliners.
cards.source_title: Digital Media Arts Center - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for Dodge College students; accessible to others during building hours.

cards.title: Health Sciences Study Commons
cards.subtitle: Rinker Campus, Building 9401
cards.notes: Located on the first floor of Building 9401 at the Rinker Campus, this space offers 12 collaborative rooms and 20 individual study spaces for graduate students.
cards.short_summary: A specialized study commons for health science students at the Irvine campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Sciences Study Commons at the Rinker Campus provides twelve collaborative study rooms and twenty individual study spaces.
cards.source_title: Rinker Campus Resources - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Primarily for Rinker students; requires Chapman ID for room reservations.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free cultural, social, and study spaces across Chapman University's Orange campus that require no admission or purchase.

cards.title: Hilbert Museum of California Art
cards.subtitle: California Scene Paintings & Narrative Art
cards.notes: Explore a world-class collection of California Scene paintings and Hollywood production art. Admission is free for everyone, though timed-entry reservations are recommended.
cards.short_summary: A free museum showcasing California's visual history through paintings and animation art.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Hilbert Museum of California Art is always free for the public and students.
cards.source_title: Hilbert Museum of California Art
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday through Sunday, 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

cards.title: Fish Interfaith Center
cards.subtitle: Spiritual Reflection & Architecture
cards.notes: Visit the Wallace All Faiths Chapel or the Prayer and Meditation Room for quiet reflection. The space is open to all beliefs and features stunning architectural design.
cards.short_summary: An inclusive interfaith center offering quiet spaces for meditation and spiritual reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fish Interfaith Center is open to the entire Chapman community and visitors for free reflection and prayer.
cards.source_title: About Fish Interfaith Center
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: Attallah Piazza
cards.subtitle: Central Campus Gathering Spot
cards.notes: Relax by the Italian-inspired fountain in the heart of campus. This open-air plaza hosts free community events like Winterfest and summer concerts.
cards.short_summary: The central social hub of campus featuring a fountain and space for free public events.
cards.evidence_claim: Attallah Piazza is a public campus space that hosts free community events like the annual Family-Friendly Concert Series.
cards.source_title: Free Family-Friendly Concert Series at Attallah Piazza
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space; event times vary by season.

cards.title: Escalette Art Walking Tour
cards.subtitle: Museum Without Walls
cards.notes: Take a self-guided walking tour of over 700 artworks displayed in hallways and public spaces across campus. Use the Bloomberg Connects app for a free digital guide.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide 'museum without walls' featuring contemporary art in public buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Escalette Permanent Art Collection is free and open to the public, with free tours available upon request.
cards.source_title: Escalette Permanent Art Collection
cards.access_notes: Art is located in various campus buildings; public access typically follows building hours.

cards.title: Guggenheim Gallery
cards.subtitle: Contemporary Art Exhibitions
cards.notes: Visit this gallery in Moulton Hall to see provocative contemporary art exhibitions. It serves as a free educational resource for students and the local community.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus gallery hosting rotating contemporary art exhibitions and programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Guggenheim Gallery is free for students and the public.
cards.source_title: Guggenheim Gallery
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 12:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., and Saturday, 11:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

cards.title: Leatherby Libraries Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Archives & Special Collections
cards.notes: Browse free exhibits including the Huell Howser Archives and the Center for American War Letters. The library is open to the public for browsing its open stack collections.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library featuring free public exhibits and specialized historical archives.
cards.evidence_claim: Leatherby Libraries offers free access to special collections and exhibits for neighbors and visitors.
cards.source_title: Leatherby Libraries - Visitors Resources
cards.access_notes: General public welcome during regular hours; late-night study commons is student-only.

cards.title: Doti Hall Patio
cards.subtitle: Quiet Outdoor Study Space
cards.notes: Head to the east side of Doti Hall for a quiet outdoor study spot. This patio features tables, benches, and umbrellas, making it a perfect free place to work between classes.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful outdoor patio with seating and shade, ideal for studying or relaxing.
cards.evidence_claim: Doti Hall patio is a quiet, free outdoor location with tables and benches for student use.
cards.source_title: Hidden Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space accessible during campus hours.

cards.entity_name: Keck Center for Science and Engineering
cards.title: Keck Center Public Spaces
cards.subtitle: Modern STEM Facility
cards.notes: Walk through the 140,000-square-foot Keck Center to see modern labs and collaborative spaces. The building features open seating areas for students to gather and study for free.
cards.short_summary: A massive, modern science facility with open collaborative spaces for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: The Keck Center features collaborative spaces and is open for student-led tours and general use.
cards.source_title: Keck Center for Science and Engineering
cards.access_notes: Building access typically follows academic hours; tours require registration.

cards.title: Dee's Garden of the Senses
cards.subtitle: Sculpted Outdoor Meditation Area
cards.notes: Located near the Fish Interfaith Center, this garden features art installations, a fountain, and lush foliage. It is a designated quiet zone for meditation and relaxation.
cards.short_summary: A tranquil outdoor garden designed for sensory experience and quiet meditation.
cards.evidence_claim: Dee's Garden of the Senses is a free outdoor space for students to meditate or find quiet.
cards.source_title: Fish Interfaith Center Facilities
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Chapman Athletics Home Games
cards.subtitle: NCAA Division III Sports
cards.notes: Cheer on the Panthers at various home games. While some events may have a nominal fee for the public, many regular-season games are free for the community to attend.
cards.short_summary: Free or low-cost sporting events featuring Chapman's 20 NCAA Division III teams.
cards.evidence_claim: Tickets for Chapman athletics home games are either free of charge or require a nominal fee.
cards.source_title: Visit Campus - Athletics
cards.access_notes: Game times and locations vary by sport; check the athletics calendar for schedules.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover ten distinct study environments across Chapman University's Orange and Rinker campuses, from high-tech labs to quiet outdoor terraces.

cards.title: Late Night Rotunda Sessions
cards.subtitle: Leatherby Libraries, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Access the 1st floor Rotunda for late-night study. It remains open until 3 AM on weeknights during the semester and 24/7 during finals week with a valid Chapman ID.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated late-night study space on the first floor of the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Study Commons located inside the First Floor Rotunda is open Monday - Friday: 12 AM - 3 AM and 24/7 during finals week.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open until 3 AM Mon-Fri; 24/7 during finals. Valid Chapman ID required for entry after hours.

cards.title: Open-Air Academic Views
cards.subtitle: Argyros Forum, Top Floor
cards.notes: Head to the top floor for an outdoor study environment featuring tables and benches. It offers a quiet alternative to the library with fresh air and campus views.
cards.short_summary: A quiet outdoor patio located on the roof of the student union building.
cards.evidence_claim: The roof patio of Argyros Forum features plenty of tables and benches and offers a peaceful environment conducive for studying.
cards.source_title: Hidden Places to Study on Campus - Chapman Blogs
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Argyros Forum building hours.

cards.title: Write on the Walls
cards.subtitle: Keck Center for Science and Engineering
cards.notes: Utilize the writable hallway walls for group brainstorming or complex problem-solving. These spaces are designed for spontaneous collaboration between STEM classes.
cards.short_summary: Hallway spaces in the Keck Center featuring walls designed for writing and collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Everything in the Keck Center, including the hallways where you can write on the walls, is designed to foster collaboration.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open during Keck Center building hours.

cards.title: High-Altitude Focus
cards.subtitle: Beckman Hall, 4th Floor
cards.notes: Find a quiet spot on the fourth floor near the faculty offices. The outdoor patio and large windows provide ample sunlight and a low-traffic environment for reading.
cards.short_summary: A quiet fourth-floor patio and hallway study area in Beckman Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The fourth floor of Beckman Hall is quiet and features the Beckman Patio and large windows with lots of sunlight.
cards.source_title: The Best Study Spots at Chapman | The Odyssey Online
cards.access_notes: Best for quiet individual study; accessible during building hours.

cards.title: Rinker Campus Research Hub
cards.subtitle: 9401 Jeronimo Road, Irvine
cards.notes: Reserve one of 12 collaborative study rooms or use the 20 individual spaces. This facility is dedicated to Rinker students and focuses on health sciences resources.
cards.short_summary: A specialized study facility for health science students at the Rinker Campus in Irvine.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Sciences Study Commons provides twelve collaborative study rooms and twenty individual study spaces for Rinker students.
cards.source_title: Rinker Campus Resources - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Rinker students, staff, and faculty. Rooms reservable up to 7 days in advance.

cards.title: Fourth Floor Fresh Air
cards.subtitle: Leatherby Libraries, 4th Floor
cards.notes: Study outdoors on the library's top floor. This terrace features comfortable seating and tables, perfect for those who prefer a breeze while they work.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor study terrace located on the fourth floor of the Leatherby Libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: Located on the 4th floor of the Leatherby Libraries, the Fashionables Terrace features outdoor tables and comfortable seating for study.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during library operating hours.

cards.title: Tech-Heavy Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Argyros Forum, Room 302
cards.notes: Access PCs, Macs, and color printing in this student union tech hub. It includes a reservable private room for group projects and a lounge area with couches.
cards.short_summary: A computer lab and study lounge in Argyros Forum with specialized printing services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Panther Digital Den (AF 302) has PCs, Macs, color printing, and a private room that can be reserved.
cards.source_title: The Best Study Spots at Chapman | The Odyssey Online
cards.access_notes: Open during Argyros Forum hours; room reservation recommended for groups.

cards.title: Performing Arts Retreat
cards.subtitle: Sandi Simon Center for Dance
cards.notes: Take advantage of the dedicated study spaces and student lounge within the brand-new dance center. It provides a modern environment for performing arts students.
cards.short_summary: A new facility for dance students that includes dedicated study and lounge areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The new Sandi Simon Center for Dance facility features classrooms, study spaces and a student lounge.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Primarily serves College of Performing Arts students.

cards.title: Quiet Courtyard Tables
cards.subtitle: Doti Hall, East Side
cards.notes: Find a table under an umbrella on the east side of Doti Hall. This spot is known for being quiet and having plenty of space to spread out study materials.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor courtyard area with shaded tables located next to Doti Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The special spot on the east-side of Doti Hall is a really quiet location with plenty of tables, benches, and umbrellas.
cards.source_title: Hidden Places to Study on Campus - Chapman Blogs
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor area; can get busy during lunch hours.

cards.title: High-Tech Group Collaboration
cards.subtitle: Leatherby Libraries
cards.notes: Reserve these rooms for groups of 8-12. They feature glass boards, Apple TV, and conferencing tools like Zoom, making them ideal for major group presentations.
cards.short_summary: Large, technology-equipped rooms in the library designed for group media work.
cards.evidence_claim: Advanced Media Rooms seat 8 to 12 people and contain a glass board, computer, TV, and Apple TV, compatible with Zoom and Teams.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Reservable up to 7 days in advance by students.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the historic streets and vibrant corridors of Old Towne Orange surrounding Chapman University, featuring local student favorites and essential community hubs.

cards.title: The Historic Orange Circle
cards.subtitle: Intersection of Chapman Ave and Glassell St
cards.notes: Gather at the central fountain of the historic traffic circle for community events, seasonal festivals, and a popular spot for student photos and relaxation.
cards.short_summary: The historic heart of Old Towne Orange and a central gathering point for the Chapman community.
cards.evidence_claim: The heart of the Old Towne Historic District is the pedestrian-friendly traffic circle where Chapman Avenue and Glassell Street meet, often called the Orange Circle or Plaza Square.
cards.source_title: The Orange Circle, aka Plaza Square, in Orange is the heart of the Old Towne Historic District
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 to the public; businesses around the circle have varying hours.

cards.title: The Coffee Shop Corridor
cards.subtitle: North Glassell Street
cards.notes: Walk this street to find student-favorite study spots like Philz Coffee and Contra Coffee & Tea, all within a few blocks of the main campus entrance.
cards.short_summary: A primary thoroughfare connecting the campus to the Plaza, lined with popular student cafes.
cards.evidence_claim: North Glassell Street features several coffee shops within walking distance of campus, including Philz Coffee and Contra Coffee & Tea.
cards.source_title: Exploring Old Towne Orange Coffee Shops
cards.access_notes: Public street; coffee shop hours typically 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Saturday Farmers Market Block
cards.subtitle: West Palm Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the Orange Home Grown Farmers & Artisans Market every Saturday morning for fresh local produce and handmade goods right next to Dodge College.
cards.short_summary: The weekly site of the local farmers market, located directly adjacent to university facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Orange Home Grown Farmers & Artisans Market is held on Palm Avenue, directly in front of Dodge College and The K Residence Hall.
cards.source_title: 5 Things To Do in Orange While Visiting Chapman
cards.access_notes: Farmers market held Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

cards.title: The Dining Destination
cards.subtitle: West Chapman Avenue
cards.notes: Explore a variety of dining options including The Taco Stand and Blue Bowl Superfoods, many of which offer discounts to Chapman students.
cards.short_summary: A busy commercial block west of the Plaza known for its diverse and student-friendly eateries.
cards.evidence_claim: West Chapman Avenue features popular dining spots like The Taco Stand and Blue Bowl Superfoods, which are recommended for students.
cards.source_title: 5 Things To Do in Orange While Visiting Chapman
cards.access_notes: Public sidewalk; restaurant hours vary, typically open until 9:00 PM or 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Civic and Library Block
cards.subtitle: East Chapman Avenue
cards.notes: Access the Orange Public Library & History Center for quiet study space and local archives, located just a short walk east of the Plaza.
cards.short_summary: Home to the city's main library and civic buildings, providing essential resources for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Towne is home to the Orange Public Library & History Center, located at 407 E. Chapman Ave.
cards.source_title: Old Towne Orange | City of Orange, CA
cards.access_notes: Library hours: Mon-Thu 10am-8pm, Fri-Sat 10am-6pm.

cards.title: The Antique District
cards.subtitle: South Glassell Street
cards.notes: Browse through numerous antique shops and vintage boutiques like DeeLux, a favorite for students looking for unique clothing and decor.
cards.short_summary: Known for its high concentration of antique dealers and vintage retail shops.
cards.evidence_claim: South Glassell Street is lined with antique and collectibles dealers and specialty shops like DeeLux.
cards.source_title: 5 Things To Do in Orange While Visiting Chapman
cards.access_notes: Public street; shops typically open 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

cards.title: The Plaza Boutique Row
cards.subtitle: North Plaza Street
cards.notes: Find local boutiques and specialty gift shops like Casa Lulo, which features Orange-themed apparel and unique local finds.
cards.short_summary: A charming row of small businesses and boutiques facing the north side of the Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: Casa Lulo on North Plaza Street is recommended for Orange-themed apparel, gifts, and decor.
cards.source_title: 5 Things To Do in Orange While Visiting Chapman
cards.access_notes: Public street; boutique hours vary by shop.

cards.title: The Transit Connection
cards.subtitle: West Walnut Avenue
cards.notes: Walk this corridor to reach the Orange Metrolink Station, providing students with easy rail access to Los Angeles and San Diego.
cards.short_summary: The primary pedestrian route connecting the campus to the regional train station.
cards.evidence_claim: The Orange Metrolink Station is easily accessible from the campus, with walking directions often utilizing Walnut and Palm Avenues.
cards.source_title: Maps & Directions - Orange - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Public street; Metrolink station operates according to train schedules.

cards.title: Historic Schoolhouse Block
cards.subtitle: North Cypress Street
cards.notes: View the historic Cypress Street Schoolhouse, a significant local landmark that now serves as part of the university's community outreach efforts.
cards.short_summary: A historic residential and institutional block featuring one of the city's oldest school buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cypress Street Schoolhouse is a historic building located at 544 N. Cypress St. and is part of the Chapman campus map.
cards.source_title: Chapman University Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is free; interior access may be restricted to university events.

cards.title: The Arts and Culture Block
cards.subtitle: North Atchison Street
cards.notes: Visit the Hilbert Museum of California Art, located right next to the train tracks, featuring a world-class collection of California scene paintings.
cards.short_summary: A cultural hub home to the university's premier art museum and proximity to the train station.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hilbert Museum of California Art is located at 167 N. Atchison St., just steps from the campus and the Metrolink tracks.
cards.source_title: Experience Summer in Orange County - Chapman Newsroom
cards.access_notes: Museum hours: Tue-Sat 10am-5pm. Admission is free with online reservation.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: From midnight runs to symbolic candle lightings, Chapman University's traditions blend its religious heritage with modern student life in the heart of Orange.

cards.title: The Midnight Undie Run
cards.subtitle: A finals week stress-reliever through Old Towne Orange
cards.notes: At midnight on the Wednesday of finals week, students gather at Schmid Gate in their underwear to run to the Orange Circle and back.
cards.short_summary: A semi-annual midnight run through the streets of Orange to relieve finals week stress.
cards.evidence_claim: The Undie Run is a student tradition held at midnight on the Wednesday of finals week, where students run from Schmid Gate to the Orange Circle.
cards.source_title: Why We Undie Run: Experts say the Chapman tradition is a display of communal rebellion
cards.access_notes: Occurs at midnight during finals week; public streets are often closed by police for safety.

cards.title: Alumni Candle Lighting Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Passing the 'Flame of Knowledge' to new Panthers
cards.notes: During orientation, alumni light candles for incoming students around the Four Pillars fountain to symbolize the passing of knowledge.
cards.short_summary: A symbolic ceremony where alumni welcome new students by passing a literal flame in the campus center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Alumni Candle Lighting Ceremony is a tradition held on the last night of orientation in the Attallah Piazza.
cards.source_title: Alumni Welcome Family Members into the Panther Fold With Candle Lighting Ceremony
cards.access_notes: Held annually during New Student Orientation in late August.

cards.title: Orientation Fountain Hopping
cards.subtitle: A late-night splash for incoming freshmen
cards.notes: Incoming students often jump into campus fountains on the night before classes start to ensure academic success for the next four years.
cards.short_summary: An unofficial rite of passage where freshmen splash through campus fountains before their first day of class.
cards.evidence_claim: Fountain hopping is a ritual where freshmen splash into campus fountains the night before classes to ensure success.
cards.source_title: Fall 2024 Vol. II by Chapbook Magazine
cards.access_notes: Typically occurs late at night during orientation week.

cards.title: The Cheverton Silver Bowl
cards.subtitle: The university's highest undergraduate honor
cards.notes: The names of top graduates are engraved on a silver bowl and bronze cup, gifts from the Class of 1929, on display in Argyros Forum.
cards.short_summary: A permanent exhibit of the university's most prestigious student award, featuring trophies from 1929.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cheverton Award trophies, a bronze cup and silver bowl, are on permanent exhibit in the Argyros Forum.
cards.source_title: SGA President Rachel Berns '24 Named Cheverton Award Winner
cards.access_notes: The trophies are visible to the public inside the Argyros Forum student union.

cards.title: Touching the Panther for Luck
cards.subtitle: A game-day ritual for student athletes
cards.notes: Student athletes, particularly football players, touch the bronze panther statue for good luck before heading to the field.
cards.short_summary: A pre-game superstition involving the school's bronze mascot statue.
cards.evidence_claim: Seniors established the tradition of touching the panther statue for good luck before games when football returned in 1994.
cards.source_title: ORANGE : Chapman Seniors to Unveil Mascot Statue
cards.access_notes: The statue is located outdoors near the athletics fields and is accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Winterfest Artificial Snowfall
cards.subtitle: A Southern California holiday miracle
cards.notes: Every December, the university hosts Winterfest, featuring a tree lighting and a magical artificial snowfall in the heart of campus.
cards.short_summary: An annual holiday celebration where it 'snows' in the middle of the Orange campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Winterfest includes a holiday tree lighting and artificial snowfall in the Attallah Piazza.
cards.source_title: Winterfest and Doy's Holiday Tree Lighting Kicks Off Holiday Season at Chapman
cards.access_notes: Held annually in early December; open to the community.

cards.title: The Short Story Dispenser
cards.subtitle: Instant literature at the push of a button
cards.notes: Students can get free, randomly selected 1, 3, or 5-minute stories printed on receipt-like paper from a kiosk in the library.
cards.short_summary: A unique library kiosk that provides free literary snacks to students on the go.
cards.evidence_claim: The Short Story Dispenser in Leatherby Libraries provides free, randomly selected stories to the Chapman community.
cards.source_title: Universities - Short Édition
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of Leatherby Libraries; available during library hours.

cards.title: The Four Pillars Symbolism
cards.subtitle: Intellectual, Physical, Social, and Spiritual
cards.notes: The central fountain features four pillars of varying heights, representing the core values of a Chapman education.
cards.short_summary: A symbolic water feature where each pillar represents a different aspect of student development.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marion Halfacre Fountain symbolizes the 'Four Pillars' of a Chapman education: intellectual, physical, social, and spiritual.
cards.source_title: The Spiritual Pillar - Reflections by Rev. Nancy Brink
cards.access_notes: Centrally located in Attallah Piazza; illuminated with red lights at night.

cards.title: The 'Preachers' Legacy
cards.subtitle: From the pulpit to the panther
cards.notes: Before becoming the Panthers, Chapman's teams were known as the Preachers, Parsons, or Deacons due to the school's religious roots.
cards.short_summary: A nod to the university's history as a Disciples of Christ institution through its former mascot names.
cards.evidence_claim: Before adopting the panther mascot in the 1920s, Chapman teams were known as The Preachers, The Parsons, or The Deacons.
cards.source_title: Our Story | Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Historical tradition documented in university archives and the 'Our Story' campus history.

cards.title: The Lost Sunken Lawn
cards.subtitle: A vanished campus landmark
cards.notes: For decades, students gathered on the 'Sunken Lawn' in front of Memorial Hall before it was filled in and leveled in 2000.
cards.short_summary: A historical gathering spot that remains a point of nostalgia for older alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sunken Lawn in front of Memorial Hall was filled in and leveled in 2000 to become the Bert Williams Mall.
cards.source_title: Chapman Timeline
cards.access_notes: Now the site of the Bert Williams Mall; historical context available in university archives.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Chapman University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Kick Off with Academic Brunch
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Welcome
cards.notes: Join fellow students and faculty for a welcome brunch on this historic lawn to start your academic journey.
cards.short_summary: A central campus lawn used for major orientation gatherings and academic welcome events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bert Williams Mall hosts the Academic Partners Brunch for new students during orientation week.
cards.source_title: Orientation | Chapman University: Welcome New Students
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; specific orientation events require student registration.

cards.title: Gather at the Campus Heart
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Social
cards.notes: Meet up by the Marion Halfacre Fountain to cool off and connect with new friends in the university's central hub.
cards.short_summary: The central gathering place of campus featuring an Italian-inspired fountain and four pillars.
cards.evidence_claim: Attallah Piazza is centrally located and serves as a primary gathering place for student events and daily interaction.
cards.source_title: Make a Day of It: Experience Chapman
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor plaza open 24/7.

cards.title: Dinner at 'The Caf'
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening Meal
cards.notes: Grab a meal at the main dining hall, featuring stations for pizza, sushi, and allergen-free options.
cards.short_summary: Chapman's primary resident dining hall located within the Sandhu Conference Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Randall Dining Commons is the main cafeteria and offers dinner service until 8:00 PM during orientation week.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation | Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open for dinner 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM during orientation; requires meal plan or payment.

cards.title: Explore the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday Night Activities
cards.notes: Visit the 'living room of campus' to check out student galleries or grab a late-night snack at the ghost kitchen.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub for student organizations, dining, and social lounging.
cards.evidence_claim: The Argyros Forum Student Union serves as the campus living room and houses student involvement offices and dining.
cards.source_title: Student Union Life - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open daily; specific dining hours vary by vendor.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Discovery
cards.notes: Scope out the five floors of resources and find a quiet carrel or a group study room for the semester ahead.
cards.short_summary: The university's main library featuring specialized archives and extensive study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Leatherby Libraries is open on weekends, typically from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM during summer/orientation periods.
cards.source_title: Opening Hours - LibCal - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open Saturday 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM; Chapman ID required for some services.

cards.title: Immerse in California Art
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Culture
cards.notes: Walk across the tracks to see narrative art and animation history. Online reservations are recommended.
cards.short_summary: A museum dedicated to the 'California Scene' painting movement and narrative art.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hilbert Museum offers free admission and is open Wednesday through Sunday from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Visit - Hilbert Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Saturday 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM; free online reservations recommended.

cards.entity_name: Keck Center for Science and Engineering
cards.title: Tour the STEM Hub
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Walk
cards.notes: Walk through the massive 140,000-square-foot facility to see the labs and collaborative 'hallway' study spaces.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art facility housing the Schmid College of Science and Technology and Fowler School of Engineering.
cards.evidence_claim: The Keck Center is a major campus landmark spanning two city blocks with specialized labs and student-led tours.
cards.source_title: Keck Center for Science and Engineering - Chapman University
cards.access_notes: General building access during business hours; labs require specific authorization.

cards.title: Catch a Performance
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Show
cards.notes: Check the calendar for world-class productions or student performances in this intimate 1,044-seat venue.
cards.short_summary: A premier performing arts center on campus known for its superior acoustics and design.
cards.evidence_claim: Musco Center hosts a variety of performances and offers students opportunities to perform and engage with artists.
cards.source_title: The Center - Musco Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Access depends on event schedule; ticket purchase typically required for shows.

cards.title: Reflect and Recharge
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Quiet
cards.notes: Visit this architectural masterpiece for a moment of meditation or to explore the diverse religious life resources.
cards.short_summary: A multi-faith center designed to support the spiritual and religious life of the Chapman community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fish Interfaith Center provides students of all faiths space to study, meditate, and pray.
cards.source_title: Campus Life at Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Open to students for meditation and prayer; check for specific service times.

cards.title: Explore the Plaza
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Outing
cards.notes: Walk two blocks to the historic district for local dining and a look at the charming antique shops and cafes.
cards.short_summary: A historic district adjacent to campus featuring the famous Orange Plaza traffic circle.
cards.evidence_claim: Chapman is located just two blocks from Old Towne Orange, a historic district with numerous dining options.
cards.source_title: Dining | Chapman University
cards.access_notes: Public historic district; walkable from campus.
